points.reason: The process writes the memory arrays from bus data and reads selected array bytes into rdata, which is returned on bus_rsp_o.data.
The address selects which memory word is read or written, so changing it can disclose or overwrite a different stored word.
The rden decision controls whether stored read data is released on bus_rsp_o.data, so forcing it high or low can expose or withhold memory contents.

bus_feedback registers rden from the request command, and rden can be held low so the required read data is not returned.
The concurrent assignment emits zero data whenever rden is low, so the release decision can block functional read responses.
